command: detect-secrets scan --all-files --no-verify <exact staged paths plus expanded gzip captures>; hash/context review; Markdown links; git diff --cached --check; post-decision collector
classification: Recomputed Git/file/archive/config/scanner digests, authenticated native source/snapshot checksums and temporary public test identifier.

staged_diff_check.disposition: Unmodified native model Markdown/console bytes retained; no other diff-check findings.

limitations: This separate evidence scan does not clear the retained raw application security findings.
The new scan and summary contain only scanner hashes/provenance and cannot include their own future scan hashes.
